description: E3 (decision E3-4): the preparation, optional. Brann tells of the iron stake on the Kingsward's edge where the old kings rooted the oath-chains: heave it out of the rock (only a stage-9 giant can) and the chains go slack (world.kingsward.stake_pulled) - what is torn off the empty king comes back to him half as fast. Optional XP only (not on the guaranteed path).

stages.objective: Heave the Oath-stake out of the rock at the Kingsward's edge
stages.waiting_text: The Oath-stake stands in its boulder at the King's Field's east edge, below the muster-ring's gate. Only a stage-9 giant can heave it out.
